lyrics:
[Intro: single acoustic guitar, room sound]

[Verse 1: bare, close male voice]
Everybody's coming up the walk with something
A casserole, a bottle, a store-bought pie
I checked my pockets twice out on the sidewalk
Got a bus pass and a lot of nerve, and I

[Chorus: handclaps, upright bass, warm]
I'm empty-handed at the door
Nothing fancy, nothing more
All I brought is "thank you"
And it's all I can afford
You said come, and I came, and I'm sure
Empty-handed at the door

[Verse 2: voice lower, guitar and bass]
The table's long and every chair's got a name on it
There's mine, in ink, like I was always meant
The host is at the head in a workman's jacket
Breaking bread and passing it. I know those hands.

[Pre-Chorus: hushed, organ enters]
There's a cup he's pouring, red and deep
He says, "This is me, for you. Take. Eat."

[Chorus: handclaps, upright bass, warm]
I'm empty-handed at the door
Nothing fancy, nothing more
All I brought is "thank you"
And it's all I can afford
You said come, and I came, and I'm sure
Empty-handed at the door

[Bridge: building, stomps, choir, shouted]
So sing, my empty hands!
Sing, my empty pockets!
The one who owns the cattle on a thousand hills
Doesn't want my wallet
He wants me. He wants me.

[Final Chorus: full band and choir]
I'm empty-handed at the door
Nothing fancy, nothing more
All I brought is "thank you"
Jesus, it's yours
You said come, and I came, and I'm sure
Empty-handed at the door

[Outro: one guitar, a chair pulled in, spoken]
Thank you.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 76 BPM, 4/4, B-flat major. Slow and bare at first, with a swaying backbeat once the claps come in.

VOICE: Male, raspy and worn, sung quietly and very close for the first verse. He opens up in the choruses and shouts the bridge with a break in his voice. A choir joins from the bridge. One spoken word to end.

INSTRUMENTS: One acoustic guitar, then handclaps, upright bass, a tambourine, Hammond organ from the pre-chorus, a kick drum and floor tom, piano, a gospel choir in the bridge and last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:42 Chorus 1 with claps. 1:10 Verse 2, the table. 1:42 Pre-chorus, the cup. 1:56 Chorus 2. 2:24 Bridge, shouted. 2:50 Final chorus with choir. 3:18 Outro, a chair and 'Thank you' at 3:26.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Rootsy and live: you can hear the room, fingers on strings and the choir standing behind him.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The shouted 'So sing, my empty hands!' at 2:24.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus are a guest with nothing to bring. At 1:10 the host wears a workman's jacket and breaks bread, and at 1:42 he pours the cup. The last chorus gives the thanks to Jesus by name.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Embarrassed, welcomed, overwhelmed, thankful.
